name: Autel du Cœur Cousu
prompt:
Original medieval fantasy RTS concept, hand-painted 2D with credible material details and readable silhouette. Match the supplied style references: brushwork, proportions, lighting, detail density, camera and faction palette. References show OTHER subjects: do not reproduce their identity, equipment or add them to the image. Exactly one complete centered subject, slightly elevated three-quarter view, ample empty margin around all extremities. Transparent background, no ground, scenery, base, interface, typography, logos or watermark. Never draw a checkerboard. If native transparency is impossible use a plain white background for extraction.
Material palette: pale Crown limestone and bronze on the left, dark Marches slate and black oak with red memory cords on the right, restrained ivory-blue Echo stitching.
Subject: AN ACTUAL OPEN RITUAL ALTAR, NOT A CLOSED STORAGE OBJECT: one wide, LOW, HORIZONTAL and THIN stone sacrificial ceremonial TABLETOP, fully exposed on top, supported by FOUR separate short sculpted stone columns with a clearly visible OPEN EMPTY SPACE between the legs UNDER the tabletop (see-through void, not a solid front wall). A distinct raised central shallow bowl-shaped witness basin and TWO recessed empty witness-tablet holders on the UPWARD-FACING tabletop, fully visible from a slightly elevated isometric three-quarter angle. Its left half is precisely dressed pale limestone and neat aged bronze Crown inlay; its right half is rough dark slate, black oak and carefully knotted deep oxblood-red Marches memory cords. A delicate narrow seam of pale white-blue Echo crystal stitching runs ACROSS the tabletop, visibly reconciling both halves. Thin corner supports and low silhouette; entire object no taller than it is wide. The important thing is the recognizable silhouette of an OPEN ALTAR WITH LEGS and distinct tabletop, not an architectural building. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: treasure chest, sarcophagus, casket, sealed stone box, coffin, closed cuboid, enclosing side walls, doors, lock, lid, solid monolithic block, rectangular storage trunk or building facade. No scenery, no landscape, no platform, no readable writing, no people, whole object isolated on transparent background with 15 percent breathing margin. ONE isolated physical stone-and-metal site structure; no terrain or environment. Match style references for brushwork and MATERIAL ONLY, never copy their subject. No readable text, no added people, no painted ground.
CRITICAL FRAMING: show the ENTIRE isolated subject, 15 percent empty margin on all four sides, about 65 percent of square canvas occupied. Preserve the exact SUBJECT SHAPE specified above, use references for PAINTING STYLE only and do NOT imitate their geometry. No atmospheric haze. Background must be uniform white if alpha unavailable.
